# Copilot Instructions

The canonical source of truth for this repository's guidance is **[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** at the repo root — read it first. This file exists only so Copilot picks up the same rules; it is intentionally thin.

Quick map:
- **Skills** — `.ai/skills/` (each `<skill>/SKILL.md`)
- **Documentation** — `docs/` (index: [`docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md))
- **Architecture & conventions** — `docs/architecture/architecture-conventions.md`, `docs/conventions/`

Do not duplicate guidance here — update `AGENTS.md` instead.
